action.description: Binance public market-data action. get_candles is the broker-neutral candle contract. screen ranks a quote asset's pairs by 24h turnover. No account or order action exists here. klines is accepted as an alias of get_candles — it is the venue's own word.

symbol.description: [agg_trades/avg_price/book_ticker/get_candles/orderbook/ticker/ticker_24h/trades] Pair or base asset. BTCUSDT, BTC, btc/usdt and BTC-USDT all resolve to BTCUSDT; a bare base asset takes the quote parameter (USDT by default).

quote.description: [screen/symbols] Quote asset — completes a bare base asset, and selects which pairs screen and symbols return. Default USDT. Binance has no KRW pairs.

interval.description: [get_candles] Candle interval, CASE SENSITIVE: 1s 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 6h 8h 12h 1d 3d 1w 1M. '1m' is one minute and '1M' is one month. Default 1d.

limit.description: [agg_trades/get_candles/orderbook/trades] How many rows. Candles page past the venue's 1000 cap up to 20000; order book allows 5000; trades allow 1000.

start.description: [agg_trades/get_candles] Range start — YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds. Interpreted as UTC.

end.description: [agg_trades/get_candles] Range end — YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds. Interpreted as UTC.

top.description: [screen] screen: how many ranked rows to return (1-200, default 30).

minTurnover.description: [screen] screen: drop pairs whose 24h turnover in the quote asset is below this.

includeStable.description: [screen] screen: keep stablecoin-against-stablecoin pairs (USDC/USDT and the like). They top every turnover ranking without moving, so they are excluded by default.

data.description: Response payload; shape depends on the action

trade.description: 바이낸스 binance 실시간 체결 스트림 — 틱 단위 체결가·체결량이 밀려옵니다. Live trade ticks. The stream name must be LOWERCASE (btcusdt@trade); pass `code` in lowercase.
